hypotheses.binder: (hNS : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ∈ S)
hypotheses.justification: This is only used to apply the Frobenius comparison at primes outside S. Without hNS, instead exclude the finite set `S ∪ N.primeFactors` in `GaloisRepAdic.charpoly_eq_of_charpoly_frobenius_eq`. For any prime outside that union, it is outside S and does not divide N, so the existing `hθ` and `hρ'` hypotheses give the same characteristic-polynomial comparison. The library uses this enlarged-exception-set argument elsewhere (for example, with `S ∪ N.primeFactors` at lines 2151–2154 of `S_CuspForm_heckeLocal_bijective_and_exists_presentation_of_ordinaryCondition_of_finiteAt_of_not_cube_dvd.lean`). The `[NeZero N]` assumption ensures the prime-factor exclusion works; no assumption about S containing the prime divisors of N is needed.
